description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It handles displaying test cases assigned to a user, including fetching data from the database, generating links for execution and editing, and rendering tables with test case details and statuses. It also includes utility functions for initializing arguments, defining table columns, and configuring UI elements.

methods.name: get_date_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in days between a given date and the current time.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing request/session parameters for the page, such as project ID, user ID, test plan ID, build ID, and display options.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Defines the columns for the test case display table, including optional columns like user, platform, priority, and status.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with titles, labels, and configuration based on input arguments.

methods.name: initFilters
methods.description: Creates filter settings for test plan and build status based on user options.

methods.name: getStatusGuiCfg
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the status code and label definitions for test case statuses.

methods.name: getQuickExecCfg
methods.description: Generates HTML snippets for quick execution icons for test case statuses.
